prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Ashen Queen, a towering six-armed sun priestess transformed by sacred fire, exactly as in Image 3: the tall humanoid torso of blackened, cracked stone-like skin with molten orange-gold light in the fissures; exactly six arms, three on each side, with the small radiant sun disc, the curved ceremonial bronze blade and the smoking censer on a chain; the radiant crown of gold rays and the cracked white ceremonial mask; no legs: the vast serpentine tail of charcoal scales with ember-lit undersides coiled around the broken stone altar; palette of charcoal, ember orange, white-gold, bronze and ash grey. FACE: the cracked white ceremonial mask with two burning slits is readable; no human face shows.

BASE: the broken stone altar under her lowest coil is part of the creature's own body, drawn joined to it with a shared black outline in every pose and resting on the ground line as its ground contact; it is not a separate prop or scenery.

Pose: lunging forward on the coiled tail toward the heroes, the three near-side arms striking in one sweeping blow with the bronze blade leading, the three far-side arms thrown back, the tail coil tightening around the altar, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Lean and twist the upper body along a strong diagonal above the coils, extend the arms and weapons far from the body, tighten or loosen the coils, and let the tail tip lash. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: a humanoid upper body on a serpent tail, no legs: coiled upright inside the box, the lowest coil resting on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, legs, feet, four arms, eight arms, a second blade, a throne, wings.
